intake.goal: Draft an external email to Acme Cloud operations about a sensitive EU customer notification pipeline runtime incident and request specific verification actions and a status update within 60 minutes.
intake.context: Incident detected at 09:12 CET on May 25, 2026; intermittent delivery failures for transactional notifications; still under investigation; no confirmed data loss; some EU tenants experienced delayed processing.
intake.domain_label: Draft incident notification email to operations (EU notification pipeline)
success_criteria: Email includes all incident timing and impact details provided (no confirmed data loss; delayed processing for some EU tenants).
Requests the three specified operational checks.
Asks for status back to the incident lead within 60 minutes.
Clearly states that investigation is ongoing and avoids over-claiming.
Targets the operations team and is suitable for external communication.
constraints: Email is addressed to the operations team at Acme Cloud.
Incident is sensitive; request operational verification without asserting unconfirmed facts.
Operations to manually verify delivery queues, check retry backlog, and confirm whether impact extended beyond the notification pipeline.
Ask for a status report back to the incident lead within 60 minutes.

planner_rationale: Create a high-sensitivity, externally suitable email to Acme Cloud operations that accurately restates the known incident timeline and impact, requests specific operational verification actions (queue health, retry backlog, and scope beyond the notification pipeline), and requests a status report back to the incident lead within 60 minutes—while avoiding unconfirmed claims and clearly indicating investigation is ongoing.

plan_steps.objective: Lock the email’s factual envelope: incident timing, observed symptoms, current investigation status, and impact qualifiers.
plan_steps.rationale: Because this is sensitive external communication, the email must be precise about what is known (and what is not) to avoid over-claiming data loss or confirmed scope.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: A concise set of incident facts ready to include verbatim or near-verbatim in the email (09:12 CET on May 25, 2026; intermittent delivery failures for transactional notifications; investigation ongoing; no confirmed data loss; some EU tenants experienced delayed processing).

plan_steps.objective: Translate the operational verification requests into clear, non-accusatory actions tailored for Acme Cloud operations.
plan_steps.rationale: The request must prompt the three manual checks specified, using language that supports operations verification without assuming fault or asserting unconfirmed cause.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: Three explicit requested verification items formulated as questions/tasks: (1) review delivery queues health/processing state for the notification runtime, (2) check retry backlog/backpressure and whether retries are draining, (3) confirm whether impact extended beyond the notification pipeline to other systems/paths (as applicable), all phrased to elicit operational confirmation.

plan_steps.objective: Define the response expectation: who should reply, the required turnaround time, and the type of status information needed.
plan_steps.rationale: The success criteria require a status report back to the incident lead within 60 minutes, so the email must clearly set the urgency and the minimum contents of the reply.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: A clearly worded call to action specifying that operations should provide a status update to the incident lead within 60 minutes, including results of the requested verification checks and any confirmed scope/next troubleshooting direction (without asserting unknowns).

plan_steps.objective: Draft the complete external email to Acme Cloud operations with appropriate tone, structure, and sensitivity controls.
plan_steps.rationale: A high-sensitivity incident email must be structured for rapid comprehension, with careful wording, clear subject/heading, and explicit qualifiers that investigation remains ongoing.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: A ready-to-send email draft addressed to the operations team that includes: incident summary with timing and impact qualifiers; statement that investigation is ongoing and no confirmed data loss; clear requested verification actions; the 60-minute status request to the incident lead; and a professional closing.

actor.summary: All required components from prior steps and the factual envelope have been integrated into a concise, high‑sensitivity email draft that meets the success criteria.
actor.output_text: Subject: Urgent: Notification Pipeline Incident – Verification Required (May 25 2026, 09:12 CET) Hi Acme Cloud Operations Team, We have detected an incident affecting the EU customer notification pipeline at **09:12 CET on May 25 2026**. The symptom is **intermittent delivery failures for transactional notifications**, resulting in **delayed processing for some EU tenants**. The investigation is ongoing; **no data loss has been confirmed** at this time. To help us assess the scope and impact, could you please perform the following checks and reply to the incident lead (John Doe, john.doe@acmecloud.com) within the next **60 minutes**? 1. **Delivery‑queue health** – Review the processing state of the notification runtime queues and confirm whether they are operating as expected. 2. **Retry backlog** – Examine any retry backlog or back‑pressure conditions and let us know if retries are being drained appropriately. 3. **Scope confirmation** – Verify whether the impact is limited to the notification pipeline or if any other services or data paths appear to be affected. Your prompt response with the results of these verifications will enable us to coordinate further investigation and communication with the affected EU customers. Thank you for your immediate attention to this matter. Best regards, [Your Name] Incident Lead – Acme Cloud
